visibleTestCases.title: Closed State Normal Passthrough
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, CB} = circuit_breaker_statem:start_link(2, 5000), Res = circuit_breaker_statem:execute(CB, fun() -> {ok, 42} end), circuit_breaker_statem:stop(CB), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: In closed state, requests execute and return successfully.

visibleTestCases.title: Tripping to Open & Immediate Fast-Fail
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, CB} = circuit_breaker_statem:start_link(2, 5000), catch circuit_breaker_statem:execute(CB, fun() -> error(fail1) end), catch circuit_breaker_statem:execute(CB, fun() -> error(fail2) end), Res = circuit_breaker_statem:execute(CB, fun() -> {ok, 42} end), circuit_breaker_statem:stop(CB), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Fails immediately without running user action fun.
